summary: Track 19.02A Fleet Adoption Hardening + Operational Editing Amendment validated end-to-end. 189/189 transportation pytest tests pass. Backend curl sweep confirms: adoption-preview returns the 7 transport-capable categories, category_totals, and summary (would_adopt=136, already_adopted=0/136, skipped=0, conflicts=0, missing_equipment_id=0, unknown_classification=4, leased_only_overlays=12); adoption-bulk dry_run writes nothing and reports would_create=136 with server elapsed_ms=90; real bulk creates 136 overlays in elapsed_ms=62 (well under 5000) and returns a batch_id; rerun is idempotent (created=0, skipped_already_adopted=136); rollback removes exactly that batch (removed=136) and is idempotent on unknown batch_id (removed=0); PATCH operational overlay accepts admin AND dispatch, persists overlay fields, rejects all 9 protected fields (vin/make/model/year/asset_id/purchase_price/engine_hours/category/is_active) with 422 + protected_fields array + 'Enterprise Equipment system' message, rejects garbage classification with 422 + enum list, returns 404 when no overlay exists, and 401 anon; bulk + rollback are admin-only (dispatch + anon -> 401). Frontend UI: /transportation-operations/trucks renders 'Fleet' header, 4 summary tiles, 2 selects (categories/ownership), bulk button [tx-fleet-bulk-adopt-btn] opens preview modal with all 6 tiles incl. [tx-fleet-bulk-would-adopt], categories-in-scope strip, safety disclaimer, and Cancel/Preview Again/Adopt CTAs. Each adopted row shows BOTH 'Edit Transportation Details' [tx-fleet-edit-{eq_id}] AND 'Open'. Edit modal [tx-fleet-edit-modal] renders all 3 sections and all 9 fields (classification, truck-type, status, division, dispatch-ready, active, safety-hold, tags, notes); save persists with no error and closes modal. Carriers page still shows pending_review chip (39 pending) and Drivers list unchanged. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth header convention: /admin/transportation/* uses X-Admin-Token (per-user directory token) NOT Authorization: Bearer. The directive's test note referencing 'portal_tokens.admin' is correct — that token value is sent via X-Admin-Token. Verified working.

Bulk adoption client wall time was ~13s due to network latency; server-reported elapsed_ms=62 is well under the 5s SLA. No issue but worth noting any frontend UX should show a spinner since the client perceives a ~10s+ wait.
Protected-field guard correctly returns the array `protected_fields` AND the human message. Excellent contract.

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing MASCI fleet (136 transport-capable, 12 leased overlays). Bulk-adopted twice during testing; final state was rolled back, then re-adopted by curl flow, then one overlay (equipment_id f61c04a6...) had operational fields written via PATCH. Subsequent test runs are idempotent — Adopt All from UI will show 'already_adopted=136' since live state is currently adopted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live DB is masci_safety_preview. 7 transport-capable categories scope: Dump Trucks(41), Tractor Trailer Trucks(12), Service Trucks(17), Water Trucks(6), Misc Trucks(4), Flatbed Trucks(3), Trailers(53) = 136 total. The 4 unknown_classification flag is expected for Misc Trucks. Bulk endpoints expect X-Admin-Token header (NOT Bearer); read endpoints accept X-Admin-Token OR X-Dispatch-Token. PATCH overlay accepts both admin and dispatch. Current overlay state after this run: 136 masci_owned overlays + 12 leased overlays adopted. Frontend testids verified: tx-fleet-bulk-adopt-btn, tx-fleet-bulk-adopt-modal, tx-fleet-bulk-would-adopt, tx-fleet-bulk-result, tx-fleet-edit-{eq_id}, tx-fleet-edit-modal, tx-fleet-edit-{classification|truck-type|status|division|dispatch-ready|active|safety-hold|tags|notes|save|cancel|close|error}.
